editorial:
Imagine trying to make it as a singer while your life is a total mess. That is exactly where you find Sun-deok. Just when she thinks things cannot get weirder, her estranged mother shows up out of nowhere. The vibe here is a wild mix of family drama and a treasure hunt. You get to follow this unlikely duo as they wander through the colorful, busy streets of Itaewon in Seoul. They are on a mission to find the younger sister, Yuri, who ran off with all their money. It feels like a road trip movie but set in a city, full of awkward conversations and funny mishaps that make you root for these broken people to fix their bond.

What really hits home is the chemistry between the mother and daughter; their bickering feels real and relatable. The pacing stays snappy, though some side plots move a bit slow. You will love the surprise secrets that pop up about Yuri, as they add a nice emotional punch. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to really soak in the bright neon lights of the city. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a cozy movie night. It is a sweet, funny ride that is perfect for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that Yuri did not just steal the money for herself. She was dealing with her own struggles and trying to find her own path in the world. In the end, the family stops fighting over the cash and starts focusing on their relationship. They reconcile through a series of heartfelt conversations and music. The movie wraps up with the family finally understanding each other and moving forward together as a team.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky family stories and colorful city settings.
